name: Trickplayer
description: Plex/Jellyfin player as synced thumbnails + subs

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connects to Plex to sign in, and to your own Plex or Jellyfin server (plex.direct or tailscale ts.net) to download trick-play frames and subtitles.

notes: Choose your picture quality. Settings now offers Auto, High, Standard and Low. Auto steps between them as the connection allows; picking one holds it there, and the choice is remembered.
Settings and Debugging tools are tidier: evenly spaced, with sliders that line up and bigger buttons and checkboxes that are easier to hit.

Debugging tools now keep only what helps with a problem: the message log, the link capture, and two quick checks — whether your glasses accept pictures, and how fast your phone prepares them. The testing tools used to tune the picture have been removed.
